assertions.description: The claim for the requested period now shows the Pending approval status, i.e. it is in the approval queue rather than Draft.
The claim detail shows the routing footer naming the approver and the submitted total, which only appears for a submitted claim.

assertions.value: This claim cannot be submitted yet
assertions.description: No outstanding validation blocker remains on the claim form.
No unconfirmed submission dialog is left open; the submission was actually confirmed.

That the attached receipts and expense lines are exactly the business-travel receipts belonging to the requested claim period (no personal or non-travel receipt such as a personal hotel charge or a team dinner attached or entered as a line) cannot be checked by substring assertions; confirm it by reading the RECEIPT INBOX statuses and the EXPENSE LINES table in the rendered page.

That the displayed Total equals the sum of the attached receipts' amounts and that each attached receipt has exactly one expense line with a matching amount cannot be checked by substring assertions; confirm by comparing the EXPENSE LINES table and Total against the receipt amounts in the rendered page.

That the cost center entered matches the signed-in user's account line in the page header cannot be checked by substring assertions, since the value is task-input dependent; confirm by comparing the Cost center field with the header account line.
